note.text: Benchmark scores climb while actual task reliability stalls, and nobody questions why the gap keeps widening. The instinct is to throw more compute, more sensors, more parameters at the problem, as if raw horsepower could substitute for a model that actually knows when it's guessing. A system that aces a leaderboard but can't tell you it's unsure is not almost done, it's unfinished in the one dimension that matters for deployment. Measurement theater dressed as progress is still theater.
